explanation: This is a direct example of physical data independence. The underlying storage changes, but the interface seen by the application stays stable, so the application keeps working.

options.text: The application must be rewritten because any storage change alters SQL semantics
The application continues to work because the change is hidden from users and programs
The database can no longer enforce keys after a storage change
The view must be replaced by a temporary table to preserve performance

prompt: A sales application reads from a view named v_orders. The physical order table is moved to a different storage structure, but the view definition and query results stay the same. Which outcome best matches the goal of the relational system?
reviewConcept: Apply data independence to a change in physical storage.

source.title: The Relational Model and Relational Algebra
